title: Best CTV Advertising Platforms Every Advertiser Should Know in 2026 | Strategus

facts.fact: The Strategus article 'Best CTV Advertising Platforms Every Advertiser Should Know in 2026' is dated August 16, 2024 on the page.
The page lists Magnite, FreeWheel, and PubMatic as example supply-side platforms (SSPs).
facts.quote: Examples include Magnite, FreeWheel, and PubMatic.

facts.fact: The page lists The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, and DV360 as example demand-side platforms (DSPs).
facts.quote: Examples include The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP, and DV360.

facts.fact: The page lists Google Ad Exchange and OpenX as example ad exchanges.
facts.quote: Examples include Google Ad Exchange and OpenX.

facts.fact: The page lists Experian and LiveRamp as example data management platforms (DMPs).
The page describes walled gardens as fully closed ecosystems in which publishers control where ads appear and what advertisers can do, and lists Amazon and Hulu as examples.
facts.quote: walled gardens, which are fully closed ecosystems. Publishers control where ads appear and what advertisers can (and can’t) do. Examples include Amazon and Hulu.

facts.fact: The page names The Trade Desk, Amazon, and Nielsen as common ad tech players used to run CTV campaigns programmatically.
facts.quote: Common players include The Trade Desk, Amazon, and Nielsen.

facts.fact: The page defines CTV as any internet-connected TV, such as a smart TV, set-top box, or gaming console, used to stream video content, bypassing traditional cable and broadcast.
facts.quote: CTV: Any internet-connected TV, such as a smart TV, a set-top box, or gaming console, used to stream video content. It bypasses traditional cable and broadcast.

facts.fact: The page defines OTT as the delivery of streaming video over the internet to any device, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, and TVs.
facts.quote: OTT: Refers to the delivery method of streaming video content over the internet to any device, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, and TVs.

facts.fact: According to the page, CTV typically relies on household-level targeting.
facts.quote: CTV typically runs on the big screen in a more “laid back” environment and relies on household-level targeting.
